summary: Full backend + frontend regression for iteration 16 (side-nav audit, /help, live-HUD mirroring, favorites persistence, add-to-calendar persistence). Backend 4/4 pytest passed. Sidebar audit: all 11 rail-nav items (railnav-*) present on every AppScaffold/SideNavigation screen (/, /plan, /training, /calendar, /routes, /progress, /community, /wellness, /connections, /settings, /help) and all 11 wide-sidebar items (nav-*) on /workouts and /workout-list — every item navigates to a real screen. Workouts nav correctly opens /workouts catalog (header 'Workouts', 'ALL WORKOUT TYPES' grid) on click from /progress rail, NOT the old live-HUD. /help renders (Getting Started + FAQ accordion expands + Ask coach + Contact) and is reachable from both the rail (/progress) and the wide sidebar (/workouts). HUD /workout?workoutId=vo2-max-intervals correctly shows 'VO2 Max Intervals' in the WORKOUT card. Favorites persist (backend POST/GET verified + UI star round-trip after reload). Add-to-Calendar persists — POST /api/calendar/schedule creates the entry, GET /api/calendar/week attaches it to the 2025-05-13 day, and the /calendar screen shows a SCHEDULED BY YOU row with the workout in the Tue 13 column and a working scheduled-remove-* button. One minor issue found and fixed by the tester: /workout-list startWorkout was only passing 'title' (not workoutId), which meant the HUD's power-profile color did not follow the workout type. Fixed in /app/frontend/app/workout-list.tsx line 149 to also pass workoutId — re-verified: FTP Intervals 4x8 now renders in yellow (threshold) instead of the default color.
action_items: None blocking. Optional: consider persisting the coach's plan-adaptation refresh trigger label from real workout metadata for consistency across screens (already correct on /workouts, /workout-list, /help).
critical_code_review_comments: workout-list.tsx: startWorkout previously passed only { title } to /workout; HUD selection needs { workoutId } to derive color/profile via getWorkout. Fixed by tester (line ~149) — now passes { title, workoutId }.
workout.tsx line 118-120 correctly falls back to params.title when workoutId missing, but workoutColor/workoutProfile only resolve from selected (workoutId). The fix above makes the two consistent.
seed_data_creation: Tester added one scheduled workout (VO2 Max Intervals on 2025-05-13) via UI to verify SCHEDULED BY YOU row; one removed via UI remove button. Pre-existing seed 'VO2 Max Intervals · 1h 10m · 85 TSS' on Tue 13 remains from previous iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sidebar testIDs: AppScaffold + plan/index/calendar/training screens use SideNavigation with 'railnav-{key}' (11 items: home, training, routes, workouts, calendar, progress, community, wellness, connections, settings, help). /workouts and /workout-list use WideSidebar with 'nav-{key}' (same 11 keys). Both sets navigate correctly to their target screens; 'workouts' opens /workouts (catalog hub), NOT /workout. On /workout-list, add-calendar posts to /api/calendar/schedule; the resulting entry is attached to /api/calendar/week days via server-side merge and rendered under the SCHEDULED BY YOU row of /calendar with a scheduled-remove-{id} button that DELETEs. Favorites are GLOBAL (no auth), stored in db.workout_prefs id='favorites'. Live HUD reads workoutId param and falls back to title; both must be passed for the profile color to match the type.
rca_of_issue: Minor HUD color-mirror gap: startWorkout in workout-list.tsx dispatched only { title } to /workout, so the HUD's getWorkout(params.workoutId) returned undefined and workoutColor/workoutProfile fell back to defaults. Reproduction: /workout-list?workout=ftp-4x8 → Start Workout → HUD shows title 'FTP Intervals 4x8' but the profile bars use the default rouge color. Fix: also pass workoutId in the params. Verified: bars now render yellow (Threshold color).
